metadata.title: Acceptability data on English right-peripheral dependents: experimental materials, analysis plans, data, and scripts
metadata.description:
Supplementary materials for an article on the syntax of English right-peripheral dependents (under review). The archive contains: the experimental materials of the two acceptability-judgment experiments reported in the article (materials_E1.csv: same-DP ordering of depictives and extraposed relative clauses, 16 items; materials_E3.csv: island sensitivity of PP vs. relative-clause extraposition in a 2x2x2 factorial design, 24 items), the filler and attention items (fillers_E1E2.csv, fillers_E3.csv), the materials of an additional experiment run with E1 and not reported in the article (materials_E2.csv), the analysis plans written before data collection (analysis_plan_E1E2.md, analysis_plan_E3.md; these plans were not deposited in a public registry), trial-level ratings of all participants before exclusions with participant identifiers replaced by pseudonyms (data_E1E2.csv, 74 participants; data_E3.csv, 112 participants), the R scripts that apply the exclusion criteria and fit the reported models (analysis_E1E2.R, analysis_E3.R), and their output on the supplied data (analysis_output_E1E2.txt, analysis_output_E3.txt). Ratings were collected on Prolific in October 2026 on a seven-point naturalness scale. See README.md in the archive for details.

Version 2 adds Experiment 4, the enlarged replication of E1 reported in Section 7.7 of the article (24 + 24 items including the 16 items of E1; 108 participants): materials_E4.csv, fillers_E4.csv, analysis_plan_E4.md (written before data collection, with a note added afterwards), data_E4.csv (trial-level ratings of all 108 participants, pseudonyms U001–U108), analysis_E4.R and analysis_output_E4.txt (which also fit the pooled E1 + E4 model). It also adds the by-item random-slope sensitivity analyses of E1 and E3 (sensitivity_random_slopes.R, sensitivity_output.txt) and a flag excl_d in the three data files marking participants excluded under criterion (d) of the analysis plans (self-reported country outside the US/UK); the E3 statistics were recomputed with that criterion applied. The archive supersedes version 1 (supplementary_materials.zip); see README.md.

Version 3 adds sensitivity analyses with fuller by-participant random-effects structures (sens_participant_slopes.R, sens_participant_slopes_output.txt): by-participant slopes for TYPE and its interactions in E3, and for ORIENTATION and the ORIENTATION × ORDER interaction in E1 and E4. No data files were changed. The archive supersedes version 2 (supplementary_materials_v3.zip); see README.md.

Version 5 (the archive numbering skips version 4, which was not deposited) adds Experiment 5, a replication of E3 with 32 new items whose plan (item audit of E3, norming criterion, exclusions, models, sample size) was written before data collection and amended twice after two norming rounds, before any rating data (analysis_plan_E5.md; not deposited in a registry): materials_E5.csv and materials_E5_round1.csv, fillers_E5.csv, the two norming rounds (norming_E5_round1.csv, norming_E5_round2.csv; 24 raters each, pseudonyms N101-N124 and N201-N224) with norming_check_E5.py, data_E5.csv (trial-level ratings of all 202 participants before exclusions, pseudonyms V001-V202, including the four post-rating attachment questions), analysis_E5.R and analysis_output_E5.txt (exclusions, primary cumulative-link model, within-type tests, z-scored linear model, bootstrap intervals, secondary analysis within plausibility readers, pooled model with the 14 unambiguous E3 items), and power_sim_E5.R with its output. It also adds the files listed under version 4 in README.md (the E4 power simulation, power_sim_E4.R, and the Satterthwaite degrees-of-freedom script, satterthwaite_df.R, with their outputs) and the E3 item audit with its item-resampled intervals (sensitivity_items_ci_E3.R, sensitivity_items_ci_E3_output.txt). Ratings for E5 were collected on Prolific on 12 October 2026. The archive supersedes version 3 (supplementary_materials_v5.zip); see README.md.

Version 6 corrects and extends the version 5 archive following an audit of the supplementary materials; no data files were changed. The E5 power simulation (power_sim_E5.R) is corrected: its by-item term varied the island × position penalty in common for both modifier types rather than the PP–RC difference; the original script and output are kept as power_sim_E5_original.R and power_sim_E5_output_original.txt, and the corrected output (power .57, .76, .87 at N = 176 for differences of 0.3, 0.4, 0.5 points) is in power_sim_E5_output.txt. analysis_E5.R now reports convergence diagnostics for every cumulative-link model (optimizer code, maximum absolute gradient, Hessian condition number) and analysis_output_E5.txt is a clean rerun; the secondary within-type test is reported from the z-scored linear model. norming_check_E5.py is corrected to read the rater column and to report the number of items reaching the criterion in both the PP and the RC version. bootstrap_participants_E5.py and its output give the participant-resampled interval with 100,000 resamples. analysis_E4.R adds the exploratory split of the E4 penalties by item origin (items reused from E1 versus new items). sensitivity_random_slopes.R applies the same preprocessing as the main analyses. analysis_plan_E5.md gains section 11, "Post hoc corrections", recording these changes. README.md is updated accordingly. The archive supersedes version 5 (supplementary_materials_v6.zip); see README.md.

title: Acceptability data on English right-peripheral dependents: experimental materials, analysis plans, data, and scripts
